name: get_threshold_exceedance
description: Identify spatial features where a climate or hazard value crosses a numeric threshold. The function can threshold an already-loaded artifact or load a registered climate layer internally.

input_artifact.description: Optional already-loaded or clipped climate artifact containing GeoJSON features and a numeric value column.

variable.description: Climate or hazard variable to threshold. Examples: 'extreme_heat_days', 'tasmax', 'heat_index'. Required if input_artifact is not provided.

region_name.description: Region to analyze. Examples: 'Fiji', 'Tonga', 'Melanesia'. Required if input_artifact is not provided.

period.description: Projection period. Examples: '2050s', '2060s', '2100s'. Required if input_artifact is not provided.

value_column.description: Optional numeric column to threshold. If omitted, the function uses the value_column metadata from the input artifact.

threshold.description: Numeric threshold value. Example: 30 for areas with at least 30 extreme heat days.

clip_to_region.description: Whether to clip the climate layer to the requested region before applying the threshold.

region_artifact.description: Optional resolved region artifact from resolve_region. Used for clipping if clip_to_region is true.

return_only_exceeding.description: If true, return only features that satisfy the threshold condition. If false, return all valid features with threshold classification columns.

include_missing_features.description: Whether to keep features with missing or non-numeric values in the output.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

input_artifact_type.description: Artifact type of the input that was thresholded.

input_layer_id.description: Layer ID of the input artifact, if available.

layer_id.description: Generated layer ID for the threshold output.

source_variable.description: Original source variable, if different from the derived variable.

source_value_column.description: Original numeric column tested against the threshold.

feature_count.description: Number of features returned in the output layer.

input_feature_count.description: Number of features in the input layer before threshold filtering.

exceedance_count.description: Number of valid features satisfying the threshold condition.

non_exceedance_count.description: Number of valid features not satisfying the threshold condition.

valid_count.description: Number of features with valid numeric values.

missing_count.description: Number of features with missing or non-numeric values.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

summary.description: Summary statistics for the threshold exceedance result.

provenance.description: Information about the threshold formula, clipping, and parent artifact.
